response.rationale: Both forms denote a document reproduction made by photocopying. Indonesian commonly uses “fotokopi,” while Malaysian formal/administrative usage commonly favors “salinan fotostat.”
response.risk_rationale: Malaysian usage may vary by register, with “fotokopi” also appearing in casual contexts.
